}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== OrangePi logo and "OPi CM5 BASE V1.2" are on top of board under the SoM. :Consists of base board and [[Orange Pi CM5 (4G32G)]] SoM
{{See also|Orange Pi CM4 Base Board (8G64G)}}
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Rockchip]] RK3588 @2.4GHz Quad-core ARM (Cortex-A76) :+ @1.8GHz Quad-Core ARM (Cortex-A55) *GPU: ''Mali-G610'' MP4 (OpenGL ES3.2, OpenCL 2.2); NPU Support 6T, :VPU (with 8K@60fps VP9 and 8K@30fps H265/H264 decoding) *Storage: 32GB eMMC 5.1 flash, :TF Card (max. 256GB)/MMC Card slot *Memory: 4GB (LPDDR4) SDRAM *Network: 1x GbE port, 2x 2.5GbE ports *USB: 1x USB 3.0, 1x USB 2.0 ports *GPIO: 12-pin FPC *Power Source: 5V/5A via USB (Type-C)
